Commentary.Commentary: That concludes the proceedings for this thrilling match. On Saturday, 19th March 2022, India Women take on Australia Women. It promises to be another close game and the match will begin at 6.30 am IST (1 am GMT). You can join us in advance for the build-up. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Stafanie Taylor the skipper of West Indies Women, says that Shamilia Connell is stable now. Tells that when it happened, it was sad to see her go down but they regrouped and finally managed to get the job done. Adds that they have to be consistent with the bat, that is the order of the tournament. Tells that they need better batting efforts. Says that Afy Fletcher was brilliant and she has worked really hard and it is good to see her hit her straps. Adds that their batting is the concern and they have to be clear to themselves about getting better in that department.

Nigar Sultana the skipper of Bangladesh Women, says that she thinks it was a very close match. Adds that all their bowlers were incredible, but she is disappointed with their batting. Mentions that they failed to build partnerships and she should have played till the end. She says that they have to work on this going forward. Informs that they were planning to utilize the conditions and their bowlers managed to do that.

Hayley Matthews is the Player of the Match for her outstanding spell of 4/15. She says that they are obviously a bit worried about Connell going down on the field. Tells that she is a fighter and will be back strong. Mentions that they didn't have enough runs on the board and they needed to create something with the ball in hand. Adds that the spinners bowled well as they all contained the batters really well not allowing them to take the easy runs. States that they played many ODIs in 2021 and that has helped them to keep up with the pressure situations.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

West Indies Women have won their third game of the tournament and they have grabbed two vital points. It's been sensational from them! West Indies Women came out to bowl in some positive intent. Their bowlers were right on cue from the word go. They grabbed a wicket in the very first over and made sure Bangladesh Women do not get away with a big partnership. All their spinners were disciplined, they hit the right area and were rewarded with the same. They did well to grab wickets at regular intervals, and always kept Bangladesh Women under pressure. Hayley Matthews was certainly the leader of the pack, she ended with 4 wickets and gave away just 15 runs in her spell. Afy Fletcher was impressive as well, she picked up 3 wickets in her spell. But it was Stafanie Taylor who took the matter into her own hands and grabbed the final wicket in the final over. Overall, it's been a scintillating performance from West Indies Women!

Bangladesh Women put on an exceptional performance with the ball but failed to chase the target. They had a golden chance here to cause another upset, but they would be disappointed ending up on the losing side. Bangladesh Women did lose two early wickets in their innings, but Fargana Hoque and Nigar Sultana fought back and rebuilt the innings. However, they could not hold on for too long and they perished soon. Once they were dismissed, wickets started to fall in a cluster, Salma Khatun did try to steady the ship, but she too failed to go on till the end. All hopes of Bangladesh Women were on Nahida Akter, who played a vital knock of 25, but she too could not help her side clinch victory.

Phew! We have witnessed yet another nail-bitter in this exuberant tournament. This game certainly went down the wire. But it was West Indies Women who held their nerves and have come out on top in this low-scoring thriller! Bangladesh Women tried hard, they did all they could do, but unfortunately, could not get over the line.

OUT! TIMBER! Thats' it! Stafanie Taylor defends 8 runs and grabs her third wicket. She ends the proceedings. This win means a lot to her and to the team. Fuller in length, on off. Fariha Trisna swings across the line but skews an under edge onto the stumps. Shemaine Campbelle starts celebrating as soon as the bails come off. The entire team runs towards Stafanie Taylor. Kudos to Bangladesh Women for showing tremendous fight and courage. But in the end, it is West Indies Women who win by 4 runs!
Full-length delivery outside the off stump. Akter works it towards the covers and the pair run the first one hard. They looked to take the second but Akter decides to stick to only a run.

TWO! A better throw would have done the job for West Indies Women! Full and on leg, Nahida Akter clips it to deep square leg. They take one and a wayward throw allows them to take a second. Trisna was struggling but the throw from the fielder is not a good one.
8 needed off the last 6 balls, with one wicket in hand. Stafanie Taylor will bowl the final over.

Length delivery outside the off stump. Akter taps that one away towards covers and sets off to the other end for a single to end the over. 8 runs needed off the final over! West Indies Women need one wicket.
Swing and a miss again! Length delivery outside the off stump. It's pace off from Dottin yet again and Akter has a swing and a miss.
Play and a miss! Slower ball, back of a length. Nahida Akter comes swinging down the track but misses.
Nahida Akter charges down the track and takes this slower ball on the full, heaves it to mid-wicket.
Slower ball, on off. Nahida Akter knocks it towards covers.
WIDE! These extras might come back to haunt West Indies Women! Takes the pace off, outside off. Nahida Akter reaches out for it but fails. Wided.
Slower ball, around off. Nahida Akter defends it to the off side.
Shortish, outside off. Nahida Akter nudges it to mid-wicket and retains the strike with a single. 10 needed off 12 balls.
Slower through the air, outside off. Nahida Akter drops it to short cover and looks for a single but aborts it quicky.
Short and on off, Nahida Akter cuts it off the back foot to covers.
WIDE! West Indies Women can't afford to give such runs at this point. Leg-lined delivery, left alone. Wide given.
Flatter and on off, punched towards extra cover.
WIDE! Pushed way to outside off this time. Nahida Akter misses her cut. Wided.
Full and outside off, Nahida Akter pushes it to covers. No run again!
Short of a length, on middle. Nahida Akter pulls it to deep square leg but denies the single.
Nahida Akter gets the single! Short and outside off, Nahida Akter slaps it past the bowler for a single.

Play halted! Shamilia Connell is facing some issues. All players run towards her. We hope she is alright. Simon Doull, on-air informs that there is an ambulance waiting. Not sure what exactly happened there to Shamilia Connel, but we hope it's nothing serious. The medical staff is on the ground helping Shamilia Connell. She gets up on her own, holding her stomach, and gets into the mini ambulance. She is being taken away. All the players are in their position and we are ready to resume.

Four dots in a row now! Length ball, outside off, slower one. Nahida Akter looks to push. The ball goes off the outside edge but it drops short of the keeper. Nahida Akter needs to take a single of the next delivery.
Pace off again, on a length, on off. Nahida Akter taps it to the off side.
Another dot! Takes the pace off again, on off. Nahida Akter drives it off the inner half back to the bowler.
Slower delivery, on middle. Nahida Akter tucks it on the leg side.

FOUR! Much much needed boundary! What a shot! Deandra Dottin overcooks it on off, Nahida Akter drives it confidently through mid off and gets a boundary. She is not giving up. Bangladesh Women still in this game.
Deandra Dottin comes back to bowl.
Angling this one across of, fuller ball. Fahima Khatun gets an inside edge onto the deck. 18 runs needed off 24 balls now!
Tosses it up, full, on middle. Fariha Trisna pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller ball, slower, outside off. Fariha Trisna knocks it towards cover. No run off the free hit!
No ball! Oh, dear! A full toss, around the helmet. Fariha Trisna dabs it towards point. No ball called for height and Free hit coming up!
Fariha Trisna is the last batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Stafanie Taylor strikes again! Surely, West Indies' game to lose now! Taylor bowls it short, on off. Jahanara Alam goes for the slog sweeo but gets a leading edge to mid-wicket where Karishma Ramharack takes a simple catch. West Indies Women one wicket away from clinching a victory.
Commentary.Howout: c Karishma Ramharack b Stafanie Taylor

Commentary.Commentary: Loopy ball, outside off. Jahanara Alam punches it away towards covers.

NOT OUT! Flatter delivery, outside off. Jahanara Alam looks to guide it down to third man but misses. West Indies Women put up an appeal for caught behind but there seems to be no bat there. They do opt for the review. UltraEdge shows no bat invovled. A review out of desperation maybe.
On a length now, around middle and off. Nahida Akter pushes it back to the bowler. Bangladesh Women need 19 runs off 30 balls now with two wickets in hand.
Pitches it up again, outside off. Jahanara Alam pushes it past the diving cover fielder for a single.
Fuller again, attacking the stumps now. Jahanara Alam pushes it towards cover.
Another overpitched delivery, outside off. Jahanara Alam drives it once again towards sweeper cover for two runs.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Very full, outside off. Jahanara Alam drives it powerfully past cover for a boundary. Important runs for Bangladesh Women!
A stifled appeal for LBW, but turned down! Fuller ball, angling down leg. Jahanara Alam looks to flic this but she misses nd gest rapped on the pads. That was sliding down leg.
Slower through the air, on off. Nahida Akter defends it out.
Flighted delivery, on off, Nahida Akter slices it behind point. Hits it in the gap and gets another couple of runs.
Leg-lined delivery, Nahida Akter nudges it to deep mid-wicket. She calls for the second run and gets it easily. Good running! Bangladesh Women not giving up yet.
Full and on off, Jahanara Alam sweeps it to deep backward square leg for a single.
A full toss, outside off. Jahanara Alam looks to heave it away but gets an under edge onto the pad.

OUT! CAUGHT! GONE! That's what West Indies Women needed. They needed momentum and it is Stafanie Taylor who gets it. This is also her 150th ODI wicket. Salma Khatun was the last known batter and with her gone, West Indies Women would be smelling victory. A soft dismissal really. Slightly short, on off. Salma Khatun tries to work it to long on but hits it straight into the palms of Karishma Ramharack at short mid-wicket. Salma Khatun stands in disbelief and starts walking back. West Indies Women need 2 wickets to win now! Jahanara Alam is the new batter in.
Commentary.Howout: c Karishma Ramharack b Stafanie Taylor

Fuller ball, outside off. Nahida Akter drives it to mid off.
DROPPED! Another chance goes down! A fuller ball, on middle. Nahida Akter pushes it back to the bowler uppishly, who gets her hands to it but fails to grab the ball.
On a length, around middle. Salma Khatun goes for the slog, but the ball goes off the inside edge towards square leg for a single.
Fuller ball now, around middle. Nahida Akter clips it to mid on for a quick single.
Shorter ball, outside off. Nahida Akter looks to cut this away, but she misses.
Shorter now, around middle. Nahida Akter pulls it towards mid-wicket for another single.
Full toss now, around middle. Salma Khatun heaves it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter ball, around off. Salma Khatun knocks it to cover.

On the pads, Nahida Akter works it to mid-wicket for a sharp single.
Short and outside off, Nahida Akter slaps it towards covers.
Full and outside off, pushed wider. Nahida Akter lets it go.
Full and on off, Akter defends it towards covers.
This is eased down to long on for a single. 100 up for Bangladesh Women!

Loopy ball, outside off, Nahida Akter lunges forward and blocks. Enf of a good spell from Karishma Ramharack. She has not got a wicket but has produced a good spell and has supported the other bowlers well. 10-3-15-0 for her!
Full and on off, Nahida Akter keeps it out.
Flighted delivery, on off. Nahida Akter defends it back to the bowler.
Floats it up, on off. Nahida Akter knocks it to mid off.
Tossed up, on off. Nahida Akter pats it back to the bowler.

Full and outside off, Salma Khatun reverse-sweeps it but straight to cover.
Quicker and angling with the arm, outside off. Salma Khatun lets it be.

Turning into the right-hander once again, fuller, around middle. Nahida Akter defends it out. End of a terrific spell by Hayley Matthews! She ends with the figures of 10-1-15-4!

Slower through the air, full, around off. Salma Khatun drives it to mid off.
Flatter ball, around off. Nahida Akter blocks it out.

Outside off, tad shorter. Nahida Akter looks to cut this away but she misses.
Angling across, fuller ball. Salma Khatun knocks it down to long off for a single.

Loopy ball, full, around off. Salma Khatun prods and defends it out.
Loopy ball, full, around middle. Nahida Akter defends it out. A double-wicket maiden! What an over this has been! The West Indies are turning it on big time.
Very full, around middle. Nahida Akter defends it out.

OUT! BOWLED! Hayley Matthews is doing a rescue job for West Indies Women! She is bowling a spell to remember. A perfect off-spinner to a right-hander and she bags her fourth wicket. Flighted delivery, outside off, Fahima Khatun is forced to press forward. She does so but the ball turns sharply and goes through the gate to disturb the stumps. Hayley Matthews is delighted and so are her teammates. West Indies Women crawling back into this game. Nahida Akter walks out to bat.

West Indies Women have taken a review for an LBW. UltraEdge shows no bat involved. Ball Tracking shows all three reds. The on-field decision will be overturned. West Indies Women retain their review.

Nigar Sultana stays back and looks to flick this, but she misses and gets rapped on her pads. A huge appeal for LBW, and the umpire says no. West Indies Women opts for a review! No bat involved confirms UltraEdge. Ball Tracker indicates three reds. The decision has been overturned. Nigar Sultana walks back.
Flatter ball, outside off. Left alone.
Flighted ball, full, around middle. Salma Khatun has tucked this towards mid-wicket.
Slower now, full, around middle. Salma Khatun pushes it back to the bowler.

Angling across around off, fuller ball. Nigar Sultana pushes it to cover.
Tosses it up, full, on middle. Nigar Sultana dances down the pitch and tonks it over the bowler's head for a brace.
NO BALL! Stafanie Taylor misses her length servers a full toss around off. Nigar Sultana pushes it towards mid off. No ball called for height! Free hit coming up!
Stafanie Taylor begins with a fuller ball, outside off. Nigar Sultana drives it towards cover.
Karishma Ramharack drops it short now, around middle. Nigar Sultana pulls it past mid-wicket for a single.
Tosses it up again, full, outside off. Nigar Sultana lunges and defends this one.
Loopy ball this time, very full, on middle. Nigar Sultana knocks it towards mid on.
Another shorter ball, around middle. Nigar Sultana hangs back and defends it out.
Flatter, shorter, outside off. Nigar Sultana punches it off the back foot towards cover.
Outside off, tad shorter. Salma Khatun opens the face of her bat and guides it past the fielder at short third man for a single.

Tossed up, outside off. Nigar Sultana prods and defends it back.
A googly, full and on off, Nigar Sultana creams it through covers. Three fielders give it a chase and one of them cuts it off before the ropes. Two taken!
Outside off, Nigar Sultana shuffles across and leaves it alone.
Once again Nigar Sultana picks out the cover fielder, this time with a backfoot punch.
Floats it up, on middle. Nigar Sultana drives it to cover.
Drifting on the pads, Nigar Sultana sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
Outside off, Nigar Sultana can't beat the cover fielder.
Short and outside off, Nigar Sultana crunches it straight to cover.

Slightly short, on off. Salma Khatun hangs back and taps it to covers.
Flatter and outside off, Salma Khatun defends it to the off side.
On the pads, Sultana clips it to behind square on the leg side for a brace. What a match this is turning out to be! Still no clear favorites here!
Tossed up, on middle. Blocked out.
Given some loop, outside off. Sultana drives it towards covers.

Full again, on middle. Nigar Sultana squeezes it out.
Full and outside off, pushed to mid off.
Tossed up, on middle, Nigar Sultana sweeps it to deeps square leg and crosses ends.
Outside off, blocked.

Shortish, on off. Sultana goes back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Tossed up, on off. Nigar Sultana lunges forward and blocks.

Slower through the air, fuller ball, around off. Salma Khatun once again sweeps this towards deep mid-wicket. Shamilia Connell runs to her right, slides, and stops the ball from crossing the ropes. Two taken!

FOUR! Top shot! Another loopy ball, full again, around middle. Salma Khatun gets down on her knee and sweeps it past square leg for a boundary.
Fuller ball, around middle. Salma Khatun knocks it towards mid on.

Much fuller now, around middle. Nigar Sultana blocks it out.
Shorter ball, outside off. Nigar Sultana cuts it towards point.
Full, around  middle, this one turns back in. Nigar Sultana defends it out.

Tossed up, on middle. Salma Khatun with a brave reverse sweep that goes past Deandra Dottin at first slip. The ball rolls to third man for a brace. Terrific over from Afy Fletcher! Two wickets in this over!
Tossed up, on off. Salma Khatun defends.
No hat-trick for Afy Fletcher! Floats it up, on off. Salma Khatun presses forward and blocks it to the off side.

OUT! LBW! Afy Fletcher is breathing fire at the moment! Back-to-back wickets for her. West Indies Women are certainly on top at the moment! Afy Fletcher serves a loopy delivery, a googly this time. This one lands around off and turns back in around middle. Ritu Moni leans to block this but she misses it completely as the ball spins in and it goes on to hit her on the pads. A huge appeal for LBW, and the umpire raises her finger. Ritu Moni opts for a review. No bat involved confirms UltraEdge. Ball Tracker shows it is the umpire's call on wickets hitting. The on-field decision stands. Afy Fletcher is on a hat-trick here!

OUT! Afy Fletcher strikes once again! She gets two wickets in two overs! West Indies Women are right back in this. What a turnaround this has been. A loopy ball, full, turning away. Rumana Ahmed leans to block this one, but she gets a slight outside edge back to the keeper. Shemaine Campbelle takes an easy there to dismiss Rumana Ahmed. Bangladesh Women lose their fourth wicket now. Ritu Moni walks out to bat.
Commentary.Howout: c Shemaine Campbelle b Afy Fletcher

Flatter and quicker, on off. Nigar Sultana gets behind and blocks.
Karishma Ramharack comes into the attack.
Outside off, Nigar Sultana drives it to cover for a single and retains the strike.
50 up for Bangladesh Women! Short and outside off, Fargana Hoque cuts it to deep cover for a single.
Floats it up, on middle. Kept out by Hoque.
WIDE! Sprays this one down the wrong line. Hoque leaves it alone. Wided.
Tossed up outside off, Fargana Hoque dabs it to point.
Flighted ball, on off. Blocked out.
Loopy ball, outside off. Nigar Sultana drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Another loopy ball, outside off this time. Fargana Hoque leans and defends it out. Good comeback by Hayley Matthews after being hit for a boundary on the first ball.
Flighted delivery, full again on middle. Fargana Hoque presses forward and blocks it out.
Flatter and shorter, around middle. Fargana Hoque pushes it back to the bowler.
Loopy deliver again, around middle. Fargana Hoque nudges this towards square leg.
Pitches it up, around middle, slower through the air again. Fargana Hoque pushes it towards mid off.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Slower through the air, wide of off, fuller ball. Fargana Hoque leans and drives it past cover-point for a boundary.
Fuller ball again, outside off. Nigar Sultana drives it towards cover.
Shorter ball, outside off. Nigar Sultana cuts it towards point. The fielder there fumbles to stop the ball, but the batters decide not to take a run.
Very full now, slower through the air, on middle. Nigar Sultana gets down on her knee and sweeps it towards square leg.
Shorter ball, turning away, outside off. Nigar Sultana pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
Fuller now, outside off. Nigar Sultana blocks this one.
FOUR! A Full toss and Nigar Sultana takes full advantage of this! A full toss, down the leg side. Nigar Sultana sweeps this fine towards fine leg for a boundary.
Outside off, shorter ball. Fargana Hoque dabs it towards the fielder at first slip, who collects the ball on a bounce.
Spinning back in, around middle, tad fuller. Fargana Hoque tucks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Full this time, around middle and off. Fargana Hoque defends it out.
Hayley Matthews pulls her length back a tad. Serves a shorter one, around middle. Fargana Hoque works it away towards mid-wicket.
Tosses it up again, full, outside off. Nigar Sultana leans and dries it past mid off for a single.
Slower through the air, pitches it up, outside off. Nigar Sultana drives it towards cover. No run there!
Loopy ball, outside off, full in length. Fargana Hoque pushes it towards mid off.
Slower through the air, full, on the pads this time. Fargana Hoque tucks it towards square leg. Nigar Sultana wanted a singe there, but she is sent back.
Floats this one up, full, around off. Fargana Hoque blocks it out.
Shorter this time, spinning away, outside off. Nigar Sultana slashes it pst point for a single.
Flighted ball again, around middle and on a fuller length. Nigar Sultana has defended this one.
Afy Fletcher begins with a loopy ball, full, around off. Nigar Sultana drives it to the fielder at cover.
Fuller ball, tosses it up, around middle. Fargana Hoque blocks it out.
Angling in, tad shorter, around middle. Nigar Sultana taps it towards square leg for a single.
Loopy ball, full, around middle. Fargana Hoque works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tad shorter now, turning in, around middle. Fargana Hoque defends it out off the back foot.
Slower through the air, full again, outside off. Fargana Hoque presses forward and defends it out.
Fuller ball, around off. Fargana Hoque leans and blocks it out.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now, 4 fielders can be placed outside the circle until the end of the 40th over.
Length ball, nipping in, outside off. Nigar Sultana lets it sail through.
Very full, on off. Nigar Sultana drives it through covers for a brace.
This is worked away to long on for a single.
Appeal for an LBW but not given! On a length, nipping in, on leg. Fargana Hoque misses her glance. She gets hit on the pads. Missing leg!
Good-length ball, on middle. Fargana Hoque keeps it out.
Better from Dottin! Short of a length, outside off. Fargana Hoque stands tall and defends.
WIDE! And again! Length ball going down leg, Fargana Hoque ignore that one. Wided.
WIDE! Short and down leg from Dottin, Fargana Hoque leaves it untouched. Wide called.
Lovely over! Lot of bounce, outside off. Nigar Sultana lets it be.
Nigar Sultana walks out to bat at number 4.

OUT! CAUGHT! Hayley Matthews gets another one! Both the openers are back in the hut now! Hayley Matthews finds turn and bounce and gets a wicket. Tossed up, outside off, turning in. Sharmin Akhter was in two minds there. Whether to leave or play and she goes halfway through the shot and ends up edging it to the first slip fielder. Deandra Dottin takes a simple catch there.
Commentary.Howout: c Deandra Dottin b Hayley Matthews

Commentary.Commentary: Flighted ball, outside off. Akhter pushes it to cover.
Outside off, steered down to third man for a single. The batters thought about the second run but settled with a single.
Full and on off, worked to mid-wicket off the inner half again.
Floats it up, outside off. Fargana Hoque drags it off the inner half to square leg.
Length ball, outside off. Played to mid off.

FOUR! A lucky boundary! A brilliant yorker on leg, Sharmin Akhter clears her front leg at the last mintute and tries to jam it out. The ball goes off the inside edge and rolls back to fine leg for a boundary.
A full toss, on middle and leg. It was a freebie but Sharmin Akhter can't get it away. Just defends it on the leg side.
Short of a length, on off. Sharmin Akhter stands tall and offers a dead bat.
Angling in a length ball, on middle. Fargana Hoque tucks it behind square on the leg side for one.
Full and on off, clipped to deep square leg for an easy two.
WIDE! Dottin starts with a wayward delivery down the leg side, swinging further away. Wide called.
An early change for West Indies Women! Deandra Dottin comes into the attack.
Drifting on the pads, Sharmin Akhter misses her flick. Mild appeal for an lbw but nothing.
Floats it up, outside off. Sharmin Akhter presses forward and blocks.
Shortish, on off. Fargana Hoque hangs back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball, outside off. Fargana Hoque defends it out.
Tossed up, on middle. Fargana Hoque pushes it to mid on.
Short and outside off, worked towards covers.
Short of a length, outside off. Fargana Hoque cuts it very late over the slip cordon. The third man fielder does well to run across and stop the ball from racing away. Just a single!
WIDE! Good leave! Full and well outside off. Left alone. Wided.
Width on offer, outside off. Fargana Hoque can't get it through. Finds the point fielder.
Length ball, outside off. Sharmin Akhter guides it to third man for a single. Bangladesh Women are doing well here by rotating the strike.
Short of a length, outside off. Sharmin Akhter lets it sail through.
Short of a length, around off. Fargana Hoque dabs it down to third man for a single.
Fuller in length, on leg. Fargana Hoque clips it to mid-wicket.
Fraction short, outside off. Sharmin Akhter hangs back and looks to cut this away but she miscues her shot towards point.
Fuller ball, spinning in, around off. Sharmin Akhter looks to tuck this away, but the ball goes off the leading edge past cover. Two taken!
Loopy delivery, full, around off. Sharmin Akhter leans and blocks this one.
Tad shorter ball, spinning in, around middle. Fargana Hoque hangs back and tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Tosses it up again, full, around middle. Fargana Hoque leans and blocks it out solidly.
Slower through the air, full, outside off. Fargana Hoque lunges and defends it out.
Pitches it up, darting it on the pads. Sharmin Akhter flicks it fine towards fine leg for a brace.
Swing and a miss! On a length, shaping away, outside off. Sharmin Akhter leans to drive this but she fails to get any bat on it.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Shamilia Connell overpitches this one, on the pads. Sharmin Akhter tucks it towards fine leg for a boundary.
Swinging in, around middle. Sharmin Akhter tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Angling in on length, fuller this time, on middle. Sharmin Akhter defends it out.
On a length, outside off. Fargana Hoque opens the face of her bat and guides it towards third man for a single.
Loopy ball, full, on middle. Sharmin Akhter leans and defends this one.
Outside off, tad quicker, and fuller this time. Fargana Hoque waits for it and cuts it towards backward point for a single.
Fraction short again, outside off. Fargana Hoque covers the line and blocks it out.
Spinning in, shorter ball, around off. Fargana Hoque hangs back and defends it out.
Full again, outside off, slower through the air. Fargana Hoque drives and finds the fielder at cover.
Loopy ball, full, on middle. Fariha Trisna defends it out.
Peach! On a length, outside off, shaping away. Sharmin Akhter looks to punch but gets beaten on the outside edge this time. Lovely movement off the pitch.
Short and outside off, Sharmin Akhter guides it to point.
Short of a length, on off, jags back in. Sharmin Akhter looks to defend but gets beaten on the inside edge.
FOUR! Off the mark! On the pads and Sharmin Akhter flicks it to deep square leg and gets a boundary. First of Bangladesh's innings!
Full again, outside off. Sharmin Akhter defends it off the front foot.
Full and outside off, Sharmin Akhter lets it go.
Shamilia Connell to bowl from the other end.
Fullish delivery, Fargana Hoque defends. A great start for West Indies Women!

OUT! LBW! What a start for West Indies Women! This is exactly what they wanted. Hayley Matthews strikes in her first over! Bangladesh Women under pressure straightaway. Tad shorter now, this one lands outside off, and turns back in around middle. Shamima Sultana hangs back and looks to pull this but she misses as the ball spins back in. She gets hit on her pads. A huge shout for LBW, and the umpire raises his finger. Shamima Sultana opts for a review! No bat involved confirms UltraEdge. Ball Tracker shows three reds. Shamima Sultana walks back early.
Fargana Hoque walks out to bat at No.3.

Bangladesh Women have opted a review for LBW. Only height could save her. UltraEdge shows a flat line as the ball passes the bat. Ball Tracking shows that the ball is pitching outside off, the impact is line and it is wickets hitting. The original decision stands. Bangladesh Women lose a review as well.
Fuller ball, turning in, around middle. Shamima Sultana tucks it towards square leg.
Loopy ball, around middle. Shamima Sultana leans and defends it out.
Flatter now, around middle. Shamima Sultana pushes it back to the bowler.
Much fuller now, outside off. Shamima Sultana leans and defends it out.
Wide! Hayley Matthews begins with a shorter ball, firing it down the leg side. Shamima Sultana looks to flick this but she misses. Wide called! Bangladesh Women are underway!
